why: A June 2026 preprint 'The Unitarity of Arthur Packets for Real Reductive Groups' (arXiv:2606.01609) claims to prove in general the unitarity conjecture, a core component of Arthur's conjectures, for real reductive groups; other 2024-2025 papers also report partial progress (weak local Arthur packets conjecture, Jiang's wavefront set conjecture) but those are more clearly adjacent/partial results.
